result.reason: The clause does not reach either playbook position because it includes no cap on renewal price increases. It also omits the 60-day renewal reminder required by the preferred position. Moreover, Customer's right is framed as termination only “following the Initial Term,” rather than a clear right to opt out before an automatic renewal. The revision unnecessarily changes Kubient's existing rolling 90-day termination right into a right exercisable only at the end of the then-current Term, contrary to the comment's assertion that the right is unchanged. That alteration does not preserve unrelated commercial intent, and the termination/non-renewal mechanics are imprecisely drafted.
